source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of constructors and destructors (PDF 58).

items: Constructor: khaas method jo object banne par us ke attributes shuru karta hai; Python mein __init__().
Destructor: __del__() object delete hone par bulaya jata aur safai ke liye istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Car:
....def __init__(self, color):
........self.color = color

....def __del__(self):
........print("Car with color", self.color, "is being deleted.")

blocks.explanation: __init__ object banne par chalta hai; __del__ object delete hone par (maslan del car se ya program ke aakhir mein).

items: Constructor __init__ naya object tayyar karta; destructor __del__ delete par safai karta hai.
